description: React component implementing the EnhancedWorkflowPerformance dashboard with various performance metrics visualizations for workflow execution data.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string (e.g., '10s', '2m 30s', or '—' if invalid).

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string into a localized date-time string or returns '—' if invalid.

methods.name: percentile
methods.description: Calculates the p-th percentile value from a list of numerical values.
